$comment: English texts of data/cards.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the System Deck, the Games Parlour's card game: its lines, types, heroes' skills, Szczęsny's tiers and words. Each key of the texts keeps the Polish number of variants, as the game picks one by index.
name: System Deck

warrior.text: A card of yours you choose hits {power}% harder this round.

archer.text: A card of yours you choose hits the rival's card you point at this round, instead of the one opposite.

mage.text: A card of yours you choose changes its type for the rest of the match.

cleric.text: If a card of yours you choose falls this round, it comes back with {power}% of its Life.

shadow.plus: The new card hits {power}% harder this round.

warmup.name: Warm-up
warmup.text: Szczęsny plays at half throttle: common and rare cards from the first lands, a few at level 2.

parlour.name: A Game at the Table
parlour.text: Rare and unique cards at levels 2 and 3. Szczęsny picks his cards against yours.

serious.name: A Serious Game
serious.text: Unique and epic creatures at levels 2 and 3. A deck better than the starter will come in handy.

masters.name: The Masters' Table
masters.text: Epic cards and elites at levels 3 and 4. Every mistake costs here.

host.name: Szczęsny's Deck
host.text: His own deck: champions and elites at levels 4 and 5. Few rise from this table with a full purse.

texts.intro: Szczęsny shuffles a deck of cards with creatures of the Bestiary. "Twelve cards, three lines, as in a real battle. Build your deck and take a seat."
texts.starterOffer: "For a good start I'll give you a deck: twelve cards, four of each type. The rest you'll win on your explorations."
texts.starterTaken: Szczęsny slides a deck of twelve cards across the table. "Yours. Play it boldly."
rules: A deck is 12 cards. Each card is a creature of the Bestiary with Attack, Life and a type: Strength, Dexterity or Magic. Strength beats Dexterity, Dexterity beats Magic and Magic beats Strength: a card deals half again as much to a card of the type it beats.

The table has three lines, as in a formation: front, middle and back. Each round Szczęsny first puts cards on his empty lines. Then you put cards from your reserve (4 cards drawn from your deck) on your empty lines. A card stays on its line until it is beaten.
After "Fight" every card hits the card opposite, all at once. With no card opposite, it hits the rival's first card from the front. A card left with no Life is beaten.
Whoever beats all of the rival's cards wins. After 20 rounds the one with more cards left wins, then the one with more Life. If they are equal, it is a draw.
The hero card is your class's skill, once a match. Your class's evolution strengthens it.

A match for a stake: win and you take twice the stake, a draw gives the stake back. You play for a stake at most 10 times a day. The first win of the day at each tier also gives the day's reward, and the first win over a tier a rare card. Training is without a stake and without rewards.

New cards are rarely left by creatures you beat on explorations and in the Labyrinth, more often by elites, champions and guardians. The same card won again raises its level, up to level 5: each level means more Attack and Life.

Every fight you win on an exploration may also give a card of a creature from a lower land. Now and then a card drops for work in a profession, for an attack on the Beast or a Guild Expedition guardian and for a completed Guild Trial: a card of a creature from the lands at your level or lower. From these sources, the cards you do not have yet come first.
Once a day Szczęsny sells a pack of three cards of creatures from lands lower than yours, for as much gold as an hour of exploring brings at your level. Cards you do not have yet come first.

Your collection gives a lasting bonus: every 10 different cards add +1% XP and +1% gold from explorations, up to +15% for all 156 cards. It works from the moment you win a card. You can see your collection and its bonus in the Encyclopedia, under "Cards".

Live matches: on the card of another player who is in the game now, you can challenge them to a card match, without a stake or for gold (from level 20 of both characters, at most 10 a day). You take turns, 30 seconds a move. Win and you take both stakes without the 5% the System takes.
win: "A good match! I didn't see that coming."
"Your win. The cards like you today."
"Well played! Next time I won't hold back."
loss: "My match. The deck forgives no mistakes."
"This time the stake stays with me."
"That was close. Shuffle and come back."
draw: "Even as on a scale. One more match?"

The beaten creature leaves a card: {card}.
lower: Among the loot lies a card of a creature from a lower land: {card}.
trial: A completed Guild Trial brought you a card: {card}.
texts.firstWin: For your first win over the tier "{tier}" Szczęsny gives you a card: {card}.

pack.offer: Three random cards of creatures from lands lower than yours. Cards you do not have yet come first.
pack.opened: Szczęsny lays three cards on the table.

live.staked: At the start of the match each side pays {stake} gold. Win and you take {pot} gold: both stakes without the {cut}% the System takes. A draw gives the stakes back.
live.free: Without a stake nobody pays and nobody takes anything. You can play such matches without a limit.
live.limits: The highest stake is {max} gold, as much as Szczęsny's highest stake at the lower of your levels. Live matches today: {used} of {limit}.
live.lowLevel: You play for gold once both characters are at level {level}, so for now only without a stake.
live.rules: {name} has 2 minutes to accept the challenge. You take turns, 30 seconds a move. Two rounds in a row without a move lose the match.
live.sent: Challenge sent. {name} has 2 minutes to accept it.
live.incomingTitle: A challenge to a card match
live.incoming: {name} ({className}, lvl {level}) challenges you to a live card match.
live.incomingStake: Stake: {stake} gold from each side. Win and you take {pot} gold.
live.incomingFree: A match without a stake: nobody pays and nobody takes anything.
live.incomingGold: You have {gold} gold. Live matches today: {used} of {limit}.
live.accepted: {name} accepts the challenge. The match begins!
live.expired: {name} does not answer. The challenge is gone.
live.lead: You start this round: {name} will see your cards and answer.
live.answer: {name} laid cards first. Next round you start.
live.theirLead: {name} starts this round. Once their cards are down, you answer them.
live.missedMe: The game made your move for you. One more round without a move and you lose.
live.missedFoe: {name} ran out of time, so the game made the move.
live.yourMove: Your move in the card match with: {name}.

won.cap: After {rounds} rounds you have more cards or more Life.
won.missed: {name} made no move for two rounds in a row.

lost.cap: After {rounds} rounds {name} has more cards or more Life.
lost.missed: Two rounds in a row without your move.

drawn.out: Both sides lost their last cards at once.

note: Cards drop from creatures beaten on explorations and in the Labyrinth, more often from elites, champions and guardians. Now and then a card also comes for work in a profession and for the Guild's fights and Trials. Play them with Szczęsny in the Games Parlour.
copies: Copies won: {copies}. One more raises the card to level {next}.
copiesTop: Copies won: {copies}. This is the top level: the card no longer drops on explorations.
chance: A beaten creature leaves this card with a {percent}% chance.
bonusNow: Collection bonus: +{xp}% XP and +{gold}% gold from explorations, for good.
bonusTop: This is the highest collection bonus.
bonusRule: Every {every} different cards raise the bonus by {xp}% XP and {gold}% gold, up to +{max}%.
